notes.title: New version with fixed checkpoints
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! :)
I uploaded a new version which fixes the problem with the checkpoints. They should work properly now. Also, If you press "R" in the game, it resets the game to the current checkpoint, and "E" puts you back to the beginning of the level. 
Have fun! ^^
